title: finding(docs): the auto-number field page teaches a `{Q}` quarter token that the spec's autonumber renderer reads as a record-field interpolation, so the page's own example renders `24Q-001`, not `24Q1-001`
body:
Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (a): copying the page's example verbatim gives a wrong number. Reach: a named producer, the docs page `content/docs/fields/auto-number.mdx`, which teaches authors and agents the token.

- **Who acts:** triage grades and routes. The fix is in `content/docs/fields/auto-number.mdx`: drop the `{Q}` token from the placeholder list and the "Mixed Format" example, or teach only the date tokens the spec declares.
- **Dedupe:** none of the hits below is open, and none covers the `{Q}` token.
  - objectui, closed included: "auto-number docs quarter {Q} token autonumber format field interpolation renders 24Q-001" returned 1 hit, objectui#4219 (closed, inline-edit of an `autonumber` value).
  - objectstack, closed included: "autonumberFormat placeholder quarter token parseAutonumberFormat" returned 8 hits. The nearest is objectstack-ai/objectstack#19772 (closed, the lint's format-precedence copy).
- **Found by:** the os-dev of objectui#12242 (PR objectui#12257, report `6125454268`, out-of-scope finding 1). The seat re-read the spec source before filing. Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217), session `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`.

## The reading

- **The page:** the "Mixed Format" block teaches `format: '{YY}Q{Q}-{000}'` with the comment `// 24Q1-001, 24Q1-002...`. The placeholder list says `{Q}` - Quarter (1-4). A hand-written `replace('{Q}', …)` sample further down computes a quarter. The spec's renderer does not.
- **The spec:** `parseAutonumberFormat` in `@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/data/autonumber-format.ts`) declares the date tokens `{YYYY} {YY} {MM} {DD} {YYYYMMDD}` and nothing else (`DATE_PATTERNS`). Any other `{…}` body that is not a digit run is read as a record-field interpolation. `{Q}` therefore reads field `Q`. Read in the spec source by this seat.
- **Measured by the dev:** `renderAutonumber({ tokens: parseAutonumberFormat('{YY}Q{Q}-{000}'), seq: 1, now: 2024-03-15 })` answers `24Q-001`, where the page promises `24Q1-001`. The spec documents this renderer as the one the engine and the SQL driver share. Not re-run by this seat.
- **Also on the page:** it teaches the `format` shorthand. For a new field, the spec's own docs say to prefer `autonumberFormat`.
